title: Uplifting conversion across the acquisition funnel with personalization using contextual bandits on AWS
summary: Generative AI makes it cheap to produce personalized content at scale, but which variation do you show each customer? Amazon Payments used a multi-objective contextual bandit on Amazon SageMaker AI to personalize an acquisition funnel, achieving a high single-digit conversion lif
reason: AWS blog case study on using contextual bandits/SageMaker for personalization. No named model release, no research artifact, no financing/M&A/partnership/market data, no policy action, and no open-source tool announcement. No active rule covers it.
